services.name: 44 Hour Full Moon Fishing Trip
services.desc: Distance 70-100 miles offshore, 2 day bag limit, big fish and plenty of snapper! Bait Cut bait (sardines & squid ) provided on board. Live Pinfish may be purchased with 48 hours in advance from your trip. 3-4 dz recommended. Private live bait wells included free in your ticket price and they are able to hold up to 4 dozen live bait. Live Shrimp: May be purchased the day of your trip for $4 per dozen. Works well for mangroves, yellowtail, scamp and hogfish. Recommended 2-6 dozen for the most advanced anglers only because shrimp is easily stolen off your hooks. Tackle For smaller snapper like mangrove snapper, vermillion, yellowtail and porgies, you want a 4ot reel with a super high gear

services.name: 12 Hour Night Fishing Trip
services.desc: Duration 12 Hours including 7-9 Full Hours of Fishing! Distance Cruising out 15 to 30 miles from shore. Depth The average depth is over 60-120 feet of water Catch Mangrove snapper, gag grouper, vermillion snapper, porgies, black sea bass, hogfish, yellowtail, kingfish in spring and fall. Bait Cut bait (sardines & squid) provided on board at no extra charge. $9 per dozen for pinfish, must be ordered more than 48hrs in advance. Great for grouper and big mangroves. 1-2 dozen recommended. $4 per dozen for live shrimp they are good for mangroves, hogfish, yellowtail, and other snapper (4 dozen recommended) Tackle We recommend 50-80 lb. test line, 4, 6, & 8 oz. sinkers, 5/0 and 7/0

services.name: 5 Hour Half Day Fishing Trip
services.desc: Duration 5 Hours including approximately 3 Hours of Fishing Time! Distance Cruising out 9 to 12 miles Depth 30 to 50 feet Catch Primarily Grey snapper (grunts), porgies, and black sea bass but if you use the live shrimp maybe some hogfish. Occasionally we catch mackerel and possible kingfish spring and fall Keep in mind this is the shortest trip closest to shore offered at Hubbard's Marina. We don't get monsters on this trip, but we catch a bunch of the smaller great eating fish and its fun for the whole family! Bait Cut squid provided on board at no extra charge. Live shrimp is available as an extra live bait option and you can get 2 doz in a souvenir bucket for $10 or 5 doz in a souvenir

services.name: 10 Hour All Day Fishing Trip
services.desc: Duration 10 Hours including approximately 6-7 Hours of Fishing Time! Distance Cruising out anywhere from 15-25 miles to fish around 60-100 feet at the captains discretion. We will do our best to put you on cooperative fish where we know they are biting best. We work hard to provide the most action and best opportunity to be as successful as possible. Catch May include Red grouper, gag grouper, mangrove snapper, grey snapper, porgies, black sea bass, hogfish, lane snapper, vermillion snapper, triggerfish, mackerel, and kingfish possible spring and fall. services.name: FireWorks Cruise
services.desc: FireWorks Cruise at Hubbard's Marina! front row view of the beaches best fireworks displays, Plus you get to see TONS of displays up and down the beaches and on clear nights even the downtown displays are visible. This is a truly once in a lifetime experience and such a great way to spend some time on the water! Duration Approx 2 Hours (could end early or end later depending on the fireworks displays, boat traffic and duration) About This is a super fun, unique and once a year chance to view the beautiful fireworks up close and personally! Our boat will cruise out of Johns pass and hang out just off the beautiful beaches to give you a front row seat for these awesome and unique festivities!

services.name: Lighted Boat Parade

services.desc: Duration 5 Hours total including approximately 3 Hours of Fishing Time after hour ride out and hour ride back! Shark species we catch vary, sometimes tigers, hammerheads, bulls, spinners, blacktips, dusky and others too! Bait Cut bait provided on board at no extra charge.
